Olivia (People Ops): Hi everyone :wave: New launch today: Backup Childcare & Emergency Childcare Stipend. Short note below and a link to the full policy + FAQ. Please share with any parents/caregivers.

Olivia (People Ops): TL;DR: We now provide an on-demand backup childcare stipend (up to $200/day, max $1,200/year) for last-minute caregiver gaps, plus access to a vetted backup provider network. Effective immediately.

Kai (Benefits): Who's eligible: full-time employees after 60 days. Part-time prorated. Contractors should contact their engagement lead; we have limited contractor coverage in specific regions.

Daniel (Eng): Nice. How do folks request same-day help? Sometimes you need coverage in a couple hours.

Sofia (People Ops): Good Q. Use the new "Emergency Childcare" flow in the HR portal or call the backup provider hotline (link on the policy page) for same-day bookings. If you incur out-of-pocket costs, submit a reimbursement with receipts; for urgent cash needs under $150 we can fast-track without full receipts (screenshot/booking confirmation ok).

Kai (Benefits): Reimbursement details: we reimburse the lesser of the actual cost or $200/day, up to $1,200/year per employee. Receipts required within 30 days for standard claims. For recurring arrangements (e.g., a backup nanny you use monthly), contact benefits@redwood.com to arrange pre-approval.

Olivia (People Ops): Provider network: vetted local agencies and app-based sitters are in the portal. Use of network is optional; stipend applies regardless of provider. If you use an unvetted provider, please confirm basic IDs and document the booking.

Daniel (Eng): Any tax implications for the stipend? Also, is this different from dependent care FSAs?

Kai (Benefits): Tax: stipend is treated as a taxable benefit in most jurisdictions. It cannot be contributed to a dependent care FSA; please consult payroll for country-specific treatment. We'll include an estimated tax impact example on the policy page.

People Ops Bot: Policy + booking link: <https://redwood-internal/hr/benefits/backup-childcare>. Intro webinar Fri 12PM PT. :calendar:

Sofia (People Ops): Manager note: when someone is using backup childcare, treat shift swaps and deadlines with empathy. Weve added a short manager checklist on the page to help organize coverage.

Olivia (People Ops): Final: this came from family benefits feedback. Tell your teams and 1:1s. If you hit edge cases (cross-border bookings, multi-child exceptions), DM @Sofia or email people-ops@redwood.com. Thanks :heart:
